title: How to offer your element
description: The author's road in the Fractera marketplace: how your element becomes a starter for other projects.

body.text: An element you built and grew a lot in your project can become a starter for other projects.

items: You offer an element from your project.
Fractera checks it by hand and writes a check report.
After the check the starter appears in the store on fractera.ai.
The profit of every sale is split in half: one half goes to the author.

body.text: The «Offer» button inside the project is still being built. For now Fractera adds starters one by one, each checked by hand.
